transkript.t: You want 3D in your videos, but Blender takes months to learn.
And a 3D artist builds you for every prop.
So Claude Code runs a prop shop inside Blender.
It's called Blender Agent Skills, 28 skills, one per job.
One Claude builds the crate, one paints the rust,
one rigs your character and makes it walk.
Another turns your street into a rainy night.
And get this, a checker hunts floating parts
Then it ships your model to Unity, Unreal, or Roblox.
and these skills are open source.
You type online and get a scene back.
Want the prop shop set up?
Comment props and I'll send it to you.
